questions.question: What does the speaker say about hard hats?

analyses.content: 录音明确说明安全帽提供所有的尺寸（offered in all sizes），直接对应选项C。
你可能会听到前半部分说安全帽强制佩戴（mandatory）或者听到无需押金（won't need to pay any deposit）而没有看清选项细节，导致错选A（所有区域都要戴，实际博物馆可摘下）或B（需要押金）。

There have been countless stories of workers being saved by helmets, which are the hard hats that you can see on the shelf beside you. So, visitors wearing helmets is mandatory in the mining area, although you are free to take them off when you're in the mining museum and picnic area. You won't need to pay any deposit, though you should return them to the counter once you finish the visit. The helmets are offered in all sizes, so choose a suitable one.

questions.question: What does the speaker say about the outside area of the mine?

analyses.content: 录音提醒大家注意外面的道路，因为地面还是湿的（still wet）会很滑，对应选项A。
你听到“repaired”或“rough surface”时容易被选项带偏，但录音说的是道路刚才“已经”修好了，且是因为以前不平整才修的，B和C都是利用原词设置的陷阱。

Our mining community is currently being refurbished for some of the main area, so please make a note of that, and you'll know what to look out for. So, when you go in or out of the mine, please pay attention to the road, for it has just been repaired because of the rough surface and can be really slippery since it's still wet.

questions.question: Visitors who have difficulty in going up and down

analyses.content: 录音提到如果上下攀爬有困难，可以向这里的工作人员求助（turn to the staff here），直接对应选项A。
句子比较长时，你可能会因为没听懂完整意思而根据前面的“signs”或“all areas”乱选，甚至脑补出残障通道（ramp），一定要等转折词but后面的核心信息出现。
All areas are clearly posted with signs, but if you have problems traveling around or climbing up and down, you can turn to the staff here, and we are happy to help.
录音直截了当地说明整个区域绝对禁止吸烟（smoking is forbidden throughout the whole community），对应选项A。
你可能会在听到“phones”时因为注意力不集中以为是不让用，但紧接着录音明确说手机当然是可以使用的（of course, use them），直接排除了干扰项C。

I hope you'll enjoy the informative indoor presentation and this self-guided tour, but you have to bear one thing in mind, that smoking is forbidden throughout the whole community. Though you can take phones and, of course, use them, you'll also be surprised that there will be more than just one place to go in the mine.

questions.question: What does the speaker say about underground tunnels?

analyses.content: 录音指出目前地下隧道只有相关工人才可以进入（only relevant workers can access it），说明目前进入受限，对应选项B。
你在听到结尾的“protective clothing”和“mandatory”时，可能因为没看清选项的否定前缀而错选C，要特别留意unnecessary这种反向考查的干扰词。

The underground tunnel is now being refurbished and only relevant workers can access it. But it will soon be all finished, and I believe it's a lovely place for you to explore around. Don't forget to wear protective clothing. It's mandatory.
从起点Reception出发，顺着正前方的路一直往北（north）走，路的最尽头就是Mill，对应图中的D位置。
做地图题最容易一上来就找不到起点，一定要先听到“we are here at the reception block”锁定自己的位置，然后跟着“straight ahead”和“north”走到底就不会跟丢。

Now, let's start by seeing where you can go. As you can see on our map in the brochure I've given you, we are here at the reception block. We have a famous mill which is used for making and processing materials such as steel and coal. To visit it, just go straight ahead, north along the path in front of you, and you'll find it at the end of the path.
从十字路口向西走，路过商店，在路的最西边尽头（west end of the road）就是博物馆，对应字母I。
你可能会在听到参照物“shop”或者“crossroads”时就停在旁边急着选G或H，必须要耐着性子听完它最终落在“最西端”（west end）这个行进终点。
To the west, there is a museum. Pass the shop around the crossroads, and it is just located at the west end of the road.
实验室位于公园南部，具体位置在商店的正对面（opposite the shop），锁定字母H。
如果对相对位置的介词不够敏感，你极其容易把“对面”（opposite）和“旁边”（next to）混淆，从而在并排的G和马路对面的H之间选错。

If you are interested in the laboratory where scientific experiments, analyses, and research are carried out, it is situated at the southern part of the park, opposite the shop. I bet you'll be happy to hear that this laboratory is also used for gold and crystal refinement, so don't miss this one for the sake of it.
咖啡馆的位置紧挨着商店（next to the shop），直接对应并排的字母G。
这句话前面铺垫了很长的美食描述，你很容易走神，导致错过了最后最关键的参照物“shop”和紧接其后的相对方位“next to”。
I assume by this time you'll all need some rest and refreshment, so we have an excellent café which caters for delicious food and beverages at the other side of the road next to the shop.
从野餐区继续往东走，有一条向北部延伸的道路（leading to the northern part），这条路的尽头就是厕所，对应字母E。
听到往东（Further east）时你可能会顺着主路一路看到最东边的停车场或F，但实际上这里有一个往北走（northern part）的转弯动作，没有跟上方向变化就会跟丢。

Of course, if you want to spend some time in the fresh air, we have a perfect picnic area which is just right and northeast of the reception block. Further east, there is a path leading to the northern part of the park, and at the end of it is the toilet.
